name: How do I choose the right contractor for a garage remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a garage remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a general contractor who handles structural carpentry, drywall, and finish work in-house while managing licensed specialty trades for electrical rough-ins. Verify that the contractor holds an A+ BBB accreditation, maintains active local references, and provides clear, itemized bids rather than vague estimates. Choosing an owner-operated service like HH Remodeling ensures the person quoting your project is the hands-on lead working directly on your framing, drywall textures, and trim, which eliminates communication breakdowns common with large multi-layered crews.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with verified BBB credentials, hands-on oversight, and direct expertise in custom framing, drywall, and finish carpentry.
